title: avd-intake/v1: what telemetry can't know about an estate (intake.json)
description: Contract C19. The operator answers these once per estate, in intake.json beside their landing zone parameters. It gives the fact register's intake.* facts their paths; hostSharing, avdMfa, reportedSymptoms, userNetworks, userSentiment, appDelivery, appCompatibility, profileSolution, hostAgents, clientAgents and agentRdpBypass are optional. Every answer is an enum, a banded sample count, a bounded score, a public Azure region or a clock time: the schema has no field for a name, a domain, an address, an ID or free text. Why each question matters is in avd-assess methods/collection.md and gaps/intake.md.

region.description: An Azure region's programmatic name, for example eastus2

sampleBand.description: Banded sample count so an individual user check cannot be singled out

linecheckSymptom.description: Closed symptom chip IDs from avd-linecheck (gaps/client-network.md)

userSentimentSummary.description: Banded, PII-free rollup of user experience ratings (1..5) and symptom chips from avd-linecheck exports; never inferred from free text.

lowRatingShare.description: Share of rated samples with rating <= 2

userNetworkEntry.description: One user network vantage point (office, branch, home, guest, partner) aggregated from avd-linecheck exports or operator testing (gaps/client-network.md).

estate.description: The same keyed pseudonym as the estate's C11 snapshot

residency.description: Fact intake.residency. Whether data must stay in named regions, and which.

preferredRegions.description: Fact intake.preferredRegions. Most preferred first; the users' own latency measurement decides between them.

existingHub.description: Fact intake.existingHub. The network the landing zone has to join, if any.

identityConstraints.description: Fact intake.identityConstraints. The identity lane the estate is held to.

workingHours.description: Fact intake.workingHours. When most users work, for power settings.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone name, for example America/Chicago

hostSharing.description: Fact intake.hostSharing (optional). Who shares a session host, which decides between pooled, personal and a separate tenant (avd-assess methods/security.md).

avdMfa.description: Fact intake.avdMfa (optional). Whether sign-in to AVD requires multifactor authentication, until a directory read can see it.

reportedSymptoms.description: Fact intake.reportedSymptoms (optional). The problems the operator reports or aggregates from user network checks, each picking a triage flow (avd-assess methods/diagnostics.md); none or unknown stand alone.

userNetworks.description: Fact intake.userNetworks (optional). Per-network reachability, region latency and banded user sentiment from avd-linecheck or operator tests (avd-assess gaps/client-network.md).

userSentiment.description: Fact intake.userSentiment (optional). Estate-wide banded user sentiment and symptom rollup from avd-linecheck exports (avd-assess gaps/client-network.md, gaps/intake.md).

appDelivery.description: Fact intake.appDelivery (optional). Every way apps reach the session hosts. host-deployment is software distribution to running hosts; app-layering is a third-party app layering or streaming product, as a category (avd-assess gaps/app-delivery-scope.md).

appCompatibility.description: Fact intake.appCompatibility (optional). Whether the estate's apps are known to run on multi-session hosts.

profileSolution.description: Fact intake.profileSolution (optional). What carries the user profile between sessions; other-profile-product is a third-party profile management product, as a category.

hostAgents.description: Fact intake.hostAgents (optional). The security agent categories on session hosts, never product names (avd-assess gaps/security-agents-scope.md); Microsoft's own antivirus and EDR are named because the published guidance is theirs. none or unknown stand alone.

clientAgents.description: Fact intake.clientAgents (optional). What sits in the path on the devices users connect from, as categories (avd-assess gaps/security-agents-scope.md); none or unknown stand alone.

agentRdpBypass.description: Fact intake.agentRdpBypass (optional). Whether RDP traffic is split out of tunnels, proxies and inspection on the user devices, the session hosts, both or neither.

m365PlaneScope.description: Fact intake.m365PlaneScope (optional). Whether the estate uses Microsoft 365 productivity configuration for AVD, manages it outside the AVD plane, or does not use M365.

powerPlatformPlaneScope.description: Fact intake.powerPlatformPlaneScope (optional). Whether the estate uses Power Platform day-2 automation for AVD.

avdScope.description: Fact intake.avdScope (optional). Whether the estate runs Azure Virtual Desktop host pools.

win365Scope.description: Fact intake.win365Scope (optional). Whether the estate runs Windows 365 Cloud PCs managed through Intune.

userLicense.description: Fact intake.userLicense (optional). Which license covers the users, deciding whether per-user access pricing applies (avd-assess gaps/finops-scope.md).

computeCommitments.description: Fact intake.computeCommitments (optional). Whether the organization holds VM reservations or a compute savings plan covering the estate (avd-assess gaps/finops-scope.md).

recoveryTime.description: Fact intake.recoveryTime (optional). After an outage, deletion or bad change, how long users of the most critical workload can be without their desktops (avd-assess gaps/reliability-scope.md).

recoveryPoint.description: Fact intake.recoveryPoint (optional). For the most critical workload, how much recent profile and app data may be lost (avd-assess gaps/reliability-scope.md).

regionRecovery.description: Fact intake.regionRecovery (optional). Whether the estate must come back after a whole region is lost (avd-assess gaps/reliability-scope.md).

recoveryDependencies.description: Fact intake.recoveryDependencies (optional). Whether identity, DNS, network paths and line-of-business apps are available in the recovery region (avd-assess gaps/reliability-scope.md).

profileData.description: Fact intake.profileData (optional). What the profile containers hold (avd-assess gaps/reliability-scope.md).

extensions.description: Optional, for upper layers only, keyed by namespace (contracts/README.md rule 1). A foundation reader ignores it.
